answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require each new identity to earn attestations from a diverse set of established agents, with each attester staking reputation that is slashed if the newcomer is later proven fake. An inlet of trusted endorsements becomes a costly bottleneck: an attacker must recruit or compromise many independent peers, risking the reputation of every colluding account. A pearl of trust grows slowly; a plume of disposable identities becomes expensive to sustain.
